<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>照护旅程</title>
<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
<script type="text/javascript" src="https://api.map.baidu.com/api?v=3.0&ak=6zXfgKZZiCdrL3MZBH7DGpjemq5IRxRC"></script>
<style>
  :root {
    --app-bg-top: #fdf9ff;
    --app-bg-bottom: #f4f6ff;
    --app-ink: #0f172a;
    --app-muted: #64748b;
    --app-line: rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.18);
    --app-card-shadow: 0 20px 44px rgba(139,92,246,.08), 0 8px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
    --app-card-shadow-strong: 0 28px 58px rgba(124,58,237,.12), 0 12px 28px rgba(15,23,42,.08);
    --app-icon-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(168,85,247,.14), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.98), inset 0 -10px 16px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    --lavender-50: #f7f2ff;
    --lavender-100: #efe5ff;
    --peach-50: #fff7ef;
    --mint-50: #eefcf5;
    --bottom-nav-space: 90px;
  }
  body {
    font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
    margin:0;
    padding:0;
    -webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;
    text-size-adjust:100%;
    color: var(--app-ink);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(196,181,253,.32), transparent 30%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 88% 10%, rgba(253,230,138,.18), transparent 18%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 92% 28%, rgba(167,243,208,.16), transparent 20%),
      radial-gradient(circle at 10% 92%, rgba(191,219,254,.18), transparent 26%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, var(--app-bg-top) 0%, var(--app-bg-bottom) 100%);
    min-height:100vh;
    min-height:100dvh;
    position:relative;
    overflow-x:hidden;
  }
  body::before {
    content:"";
    position:fixed;
    inset:0;
    background:
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.34), transparent 36%),
      repeating-linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06) 0 1px, transparent 1px 18px);
    pointer-events:none;
    opacity:.72;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; }
  .app-shell {
    position:relative;
    isolation:isolate;
    overflow-x:hidden;
    min-height:100vh;
    min-height:100dvh;
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    padding-bottom:calc(var(--bottom-nav-space) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px)) !important;
  }
  .app-shell::before {
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:14px 12px auto;
    height:120px;
    border-radius:28px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(255,255,255,.42));
    box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(196,181,253,.18);
    filter:blur(8px);
    z-index:-1;
  }
  .app-header {
    margin:0 10px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.8);
    border-top:none;
    border-radius:0 0 24px 24px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.92), rgba(248,250,252,.82));
    backdrop-filter:blur(20px) saturate(1.3);
    box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.09), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .status-pill {
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(251,191,36,.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65);
  }
  .condition-chip {
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.12), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
    transform:translateY(0);
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
  }
  .context-chip {
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:6px 10px;
    border-radius:999px;
    font-size:.74rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#334155;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(203,213,225,.95);
    box-shadow:0 6px 14px rgba(148,163,184,.12);
  }
  .condition-chip:hover {
    transform:translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.35);
  }
  .ai-panel {
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.94), rgba(248,250,252,.88));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
  }
  .top-overview-panel {
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(239,246,255,.96), rgba(248,250,252,.92));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
  }
  .ai-panel-kicker {
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #f8fbff 0%, #ddeafe 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
  }
  .top-overview-kicker {
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #dbeafe 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
  }
  .hero-welcome-card {
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.5fr) minmax(110px,.9fr);
    gap:14px;
    padding:18px;
    border-radius:30px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at top right, rgba(129,140,248,.18), transparent 30%),
      linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%, rgba(243,244,255,.96) 48%, rgba(237,233,254,.94) 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow-strong);
    overflow:hidden;
    position:relative;
  }
  .hero-welcome-card::before {
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    right:22px;
    top:20px;
    width:88px;
    height:88px;
    border-radius:28px;
    background:
      linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(255,255,255,.94), rgba(237,233,254,.78)),
      radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.9), transparent 40%);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(124,58,237,.1);
    opacity:.85;
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-welcome-card::after {
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:auto -30px -35px auto;
    width:170px;
    height:170px;
    border-radius:50%;
    background:radial-gradient(circle, rgba(167,139,250,.22) 0%, rgba(250,245,255,.08) 42%, transparent 72%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .hero-welcome-eyebrow { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:800; color:#7c3aed; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .hero-welcome-title { font-size:1.58rem; line-height:1.2; font-weight:900; color:#111827; margin:0 0 10px; letter-spacing:-.02em; }
  .hero-welcome-summary { font-size:.94rem; line-height:1.65; color:#334155; margin:0 0 12px; }
  .hero-welcome-note {
    font-size:.9rem;
    line-height:1.7;
    color:#312e81;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    border:1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.55);
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:12px 14px;
    box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.08);
  }
  .hero-welcome-meta { margin-top:12px; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:700; color:#64748b; }
  .hero-welcome-visual {
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:flex-end;
    justify-content:space-between;
    position:relative;
    min-height:172px;
  }
  .hero-avatar-badge {
    width:68px;
    height:68px;
    border-radius:22px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:1.4rem;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#334155;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #e0f2fe 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .hero-assistant-orb {
    width:96px;
    height:96px;
    border-radius:30px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:2.4rem;
    color:#6d28d9;
    background:
      radial-gradient(circle at 35% 28%, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(255,255,255,.54) 34%, transparent 35%),
      linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.96), rgba(233,213,255,.96));
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.95);
    box-shadow:0 22px 34px rgba(124,58,237,.16), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95);
  }
  .quick-nav-strip {
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap:10px;
    padding:0 12px;
  }
  .quick-nav-btn {
    border:none;
    border-radius:18px;
    padding:12px 10px;
    text-align:center;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.96), rgba(239,246,255,.92));
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .quick-nav-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 16px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.09); }
  .quick-nav-btn.active { border-color:rgba(139,92,246,.42); background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(243,244,255,.98), rgba(237,233,254,.92)); }
  .quick-nav-icon { font-size:1.15rem; line-height:1; }
  .quick-nav-title { margin-top:6px; font-size:.78rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .quick-nav-copy { margin-top:2px; font-size:.68rem; line-height:1.4; color:#64748b; }
  .status-overview-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(248,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .status-overview-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; }
  .status-overview-label { font-size:.92rem; color:#0f172a; font-weight:800; }
  .status-overview-score { margin-top:6px; font-size:3rem; line-height:1; font-weight:900; color:#111827; letter-spacing:-.04em; }
  .status-overview-score span { font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; color:#94a3b8; margin-left:4px; }
  .status-overview-caption { margin-top:8px; font-size:.86rem; font-weight:800; }
  .status-overview-ring {
    position:relative;
    width:88px;
    height:88px;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:8px;
    background:conic-gradient(from 180deg, rgba(124,58,237,.2), rgba(139,92,246,.92), rgba(59,130,246,.78));
    box-shadow:0 20px 32px rgba(99,102,241,.18);
  }
  .status-overview-ring-fill { width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:999px; opacity:.92; }
  .status-overview-ring-text {
    position:absolute;
    inset:15px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:#fff;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:1.1rem;
    font-weight:900;
    color:#1f2937;
    box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.96);
  }
  .status-overview-progress { margin-top:14px; height:10px; border-radius:999px; background:#ede9fe; overflow:hidden; }
  .status-overview-progress-bar { height:100%; border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(90deg, #8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 55%, #4f46e5 100%); }
  .status-overview-foot { margin-top:12px; font-size:.84rem; line-height:1.65; color:#475569; }
  .dashboard-panel {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(247,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .dashboard-panel-head { margin-bottom:12px; }
  .dashboard-panel-title { font-size:1rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .dashboard-panel-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.8rem; color:#64748b; line-height:1.5; }
  .dashboard-metric-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:12px; }
  .dashboard-metric-card {
    border-radius:20px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #f8fbff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
    padding:14px;
    min-height:132px;
  }
  .dashboard-metric-icon { font-size:1.35rem; margin-bottom:8px; }
  .dashboard-metric-title { font-size:.78rem; font-weight:800; color:#64748b; }
  .dashboard-metric-value { margin-top:6px; font-size:1.28rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; line-height:1.15; }
  .dashboard-metric-note { margin-top:7px; font-size:.75rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .dashboard-progress-card {
    margin-top:14px;
    border-radius:20px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245,243,255,.96), rgba(255,255,255,.95));
    border:1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.55);
    padding:14px 15px;
  }
  .dashboard-progress-title { font-size:.82rem; font-weight:850; color:#6d28d9; }
  .dashboard-progress-copy { margin-top:6px; font-size:.84rem; line-height:1.65; color:#475569; }
  .score-overview-card {
    margin-bottom:14px;
    border-radius:24px;
    padding:16px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,.12), rgba(255,255,255,.98) 58%);
    border:1px solid rgba(196,181,253,.55);
    box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(99,102,241,.12);
  }
  .score-overview-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; }
  .score-overview-kicker { font-size:.78rem; font-weight:800; color:#7c3aed; }
  .score-overview-value { margin-top:6px; font-size:2.3rem; line-height:1; font-weight:900; color:#111827; letter-spacing:-.04em; }
  .score-overview-value span { margin-left:4px; font-size:.92rem; font-weight:700; color:#94a3b8; }
  .score-overview-delta {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:7px 10px; border-radius:999px;
    font-size:.74rem; font-weight:800;
  }
  .score-overview-rail, .score-rail-wrap {
    position:relative;
    margin-top:14px;
    height:10px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:rgba(226,232,240,.9);
    overflow:visible;
  }
  .score-overview-fill, .score-rail-fill {
    position:absolute;
    left:0;
    top:0;
    height:100%;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg, #c4b5fd 0%, #8b5cf6 48%, #4f46e5 100%);
  }
  .score-rail-marker {
    position:absolute;
    top:50%;
    width:14px;
    height:14px;
    border-radius:999px;
    transform:translate(-50%, -50%);
    background:#fff;
    border:2px solid #cbd5e1;
    box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(15,23,42,.12);
  }
  .score-rail-marker.current { border-color:#7c3aed; background:#7c3aed; }
  .score-rail-marker.target { border-style:dashed; background:#fff7ed; border-color:#f59e0b; }
  .score-rail-legend {
    margin-top:10px;
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:8px;
    font-size:.7rem;
    font-weight:700;
    color:#64748b;
  }
  .score-card-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:10px; }
  .score-card-main { flex:1; min-width:0; }
  .score-card-icon {
    width:38px; height:38px; margin-bottom:0; border-radius:14px; display:flex;
    align-items:center; justify-content:center; background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
    box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95), 0 10px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.06);
  }
  .score-card-badge {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:6px 9px; border-radius:999px;
    border:1px solid rgba(148,163,184,.25); font-size:.68rem; font-weight:800; white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .score-delta-chip {
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin-top:10px; padding:6px 10px;
    border-radius:999px; font-size:.71rem; font-weight:800;
  }
  .trend-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(247,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .trend-card-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-bottom:14px; }
  .trend-card-head > div { min-width:0; }
  .trend-card-title { font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .trend-card-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.82rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .trend-range-tabs {
    display:inline-grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
    gap:6px;
    padding:5px;
    border-radius:999px;
    background:#f1f5f9;
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
  }
  .trend-range-btn {
    border:none;
    background:transparent;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:8px 12px;
    font-size:.75rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#64748b;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:all .18s ease;
  }
  .trend-range-btn.active {
    color:#6d28d9;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #ede9fe 100%);
    box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(99,102,241,.12);
  }
  .trend-insight-chip {
    padding:8px 10px;
    border-radius:16px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(191,219,254,.95);
    font-size:.74rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#2563eb;
    white-space:normal;
    line-height:1.45;
    max-width:100%;
  }
  .trend-metric-stack { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:12px; }
  .trend-metric-card {
    border-radius:22px;
    padding:14px;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #fbfdff 100%);
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.04);
  }
  .trend-metric-top { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; }
  .trend-metric-kicker { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .trend-metric-icon {
    width:34px;
    height:34px;
    border-radius:12px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    font-size:1rem;
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #eff6ff 100%);
    box-shadow:var(--app-icon-shadow);
  }
  .trend-metric-label { font-size:.8rem; font-weight:800; color:#64748b; }
  .trend-metric-value { margin-top:3px; font-size:1.2rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .trend-metric-delta { font-size:.75rem; font-weight:800; }
  .trend-metric-copy { margin-top:8px; font-size:.76rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .trend-chart { width:100%; height:76px; margin-top:10px; display:block; }
  .trend-axis { margin-top:6px; display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:.68rem; color:#94a3b8; }
  .priority-plan-card {
    border-radius:28px;
    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.94);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.98), rgba(249,250,255,.96));
    box-shadow:var(--app-card-shadow);
    padding:18px;
  }
  .priority-plan-head { margin-bottom:14px; }
  .priority-plan-title { font-size:1.04rem; font-weight:850; color:#0f172a; }
  .priority-plan-copy { margin-top:4px; font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.55; color:#64748b; }
  .priority-task-card {
    border-radius:22px;
    border:1px solid rgba(226,232,240,.95);
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff 0%, #fbfcff 100%);
    box-shadow:0 12px 22px rgba(15,23,42,.05);
    padding:14px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
  }
  .priority-task-main { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto; gap:12px; align-items:flex-start; }
  .priority-task-index {
    width:32px;
    height:32px;
    border-radius:999px;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
    color:#fff;
    font-size:.9rem;
    font-weight:900;
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.24);
  }
  .priority-task-title { font-size:1rem; font-weight:800; line-height:1.45; color:#111827; }
  .priority-task-reason { margin-top:8px; font-size:.8rem; line-height:1.6; color:#f97316; font-weight:700; }
  .priority-task-emoji { font-size:2.1rem; line-height:1; filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 18px rgba(148,163,184,.16)); }
  .priority-task-actions { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); gap:8px; margin-top:12px; }
  .priority-task-btn {
    border:none;
    border-radius:999px;
    padding:10px 12px;
    font-size:.78rem;
    font-weight:800;
    color:#fff;
    cursor:pointer;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6 0%, #7c3aed 100%);
    box-shadow:0 12px 20px rgba(124,58,237,.18);
    transition:background .18s ease, color .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease, border-color .18s ease;
  }
  .priority-task-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); }
  .priority-task-btn.active {
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,#10b981 0%, #059669 100%);
    box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(16,185,129,.14), 0 12px 20px rgba(5,150,105,.18);
  }
  .priority-task-btn.secondary {

function buildTrendSparkline(values, color) {
  if (!Array.isArray(values) || !values.length) return "";
  const width = 320;
  const height = 76;
  const pad = 6;
  const min = Math.min(...values);
  const max = Math.max(...values);
  const span = Math.max(max - min, 1);
  const points = values.map((val, idx) => {
    const x = pad + (idx * (width - pad * 2)) / Math.max(values.length - 1, 1);
    const y = height - pad - ((val - min) / span) * (height - pad * 2);
    return [x, y];
  });
  function smoothPath(items) {
    if (items.length === 1) return `M ${items[0][0].toFixed(1)} ${items[0][1].toFixed(1)}`;
    let d = `M ${items[0][0].toFixed(1)} ${items[0][1].toFixed(1)}`;
    for (let i = 0; i < items.length - 1; i++) {
      const [x0, y0] = items[i];
      const [x1, y1] = items[i + 1];
      const dx = (x1 - x0) * 0.45;
      d += ` C ${(x0 + dx).toFixed(1)} ${y0.toFixed(1)}, ${(x1 - dx).toFixed(1)} ${y1.toFixed(1)}, ${x1.toFixed(1)} ${y1.toFixed(1)}`;
    }
    return d;
  }
  const line = smoothPath(points);
  const area = `${line} L ${width} ${height} L 0 ${height} Z`;
  const last = points[points.length - 1];
  const dots = points.map(([x, y], idx) => {
    const isActive = idx === points.length - 1;
    return `<circle class="trend-point-dot ${isActive ? 'active' : ''}" data-point-index="${idx}" onclick="setTrendPointFromDot(this)" cx="${x.toFixed(1)}" cy="${y.toFixed(1)}" r="${isActive ? '3.3' : '2.4'}" fill="#fff" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="1.7" opacity="${isActive ? '1' : '.62'}"></circle>`;
  }).join("");
  const gradId = "trendFill" + Math.abs(color.split("").reduce((sum, ch) => sum + ch.charCodeAt(0), 0));
  return `
    <svg class="trend-chart" viewBox="0 0 ${width} ${height}" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true">
      <defs>
        <linearGradient id="${gradId}" x1="0" x2="0" y1="0" y2="1">
          <stop offset="0%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0.22"></stop>
          <stop offset="100%" stop-color="${color}" stop-opacity="0"></stop>
        </linearGradient>
      </defs>
      <path class="trend-area" d="${area}" fill="url(#${gradId})" stroke="none"></path>
      <path d="${line}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>
      ${dots}
      <circle class="trend-selected-dot" cx="${last[0].toFixed(1)}" cy="${last[1].toFixed(1)}" r="5.2" fill="#fff" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2.3"></circle>
    </svg>`;
}

function updateTrendPoint(sourceEl, forcedIndex) {
  const card = sourceEl.closest(".trend-metric-card");
  if (!card) return;
  const rangeKey = card.dataset.rangeKey;
  const metricIndex = Number(card.dataset.metricIndex || 0);
  const pointIndex = Number(forcedIndex ?? sourceEl.dataset.pointIndex ?? 0);
  const metric = (TREND_DATA[rangeKey] && TREND_DATA[rangeKey].metrics || [])[metricIndex] || {};
  const point = (metric.points || [])[pointIndex];
  const readout = card.querySelector(".trend-point-readout");
  if (readout && point) readout.textContent = `${point.label || ""} · ${point.display || point.value || ""}`;

  card.querySelectorAll(".trend-point-dot").forEach(function(dot) {
    const active = Number(dot.dataset.pointIndex || 0) === pointIndex;
    dot.classList.toggle("active", active);
    dot.setAttribute("r", active ? "3.3" : "2.4");
    dot.setAttribute("opacity", active ? "1" : ".62");
  });
  const selected = card.querySelector(".trend-selected-dot");
  const dot = card.querySelector(`.trend-point-dot[data-point-index="${pointIndex}"]`);
  if (selected && dot) {
    selected.setAttribute("cx", dot.getAttribute("cx"));
    selected.setAttribute("cy", dot.getAttribute("cy"));
  }
}

function setTrendPointFromDot(dot) {
  updateTrendPoint(dot, Number(dot.dataset.pointIndex || 0));
}

function renderTrendRange(rangeKey) {
  const data = TREND_DATA[String(rangeKey)];
  if (!data) return;
  document.querySelectorAll(".trend-range-btn").forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.classList.toggle("active", btn.dataset.range === String(rangeKey));
  });
  const shell = document.getElementById("trendMetricStack");
  const chip = document.getElementById("trendInsightChip");
  if (chip && data.insight) chip.textContent = data.insight;
  if (!shell) return;
  shell.innerHTML = (data.metrics || []).map(function(metric, metricIndex) {
    const deltaColor = metric.delta_direction === "down" ? "#f97316" : (metric.delta_direction === "up" ? "#10b981" : "#64748b");
    const points = metric.points || [];
    const lastPointIndex = Math.max(points.length - 1, 0);
    const lastPoint = points[lastPointIndex] || null;
    const readout = points.length ? `<div class="trend-point-readout">${lastPoint ? `${lastPoint.label || ""} · ${lastPoint.display || lastPoint.value || ""}` : ""}</div>` : "";
    return `
      <div class="trend-metric-card" data-range-key="${String(rangeKey)}" data-metric-index="${metricIndex}">
        <div class="trend-metric-top">
          <div class="trend-metric-kicker">
            <div class="trend-metric-icon">${metric.icon}</div>
            <div>
              <div class="trend-metric-label">${metric.label}</div>
              <div class="trend-metric-value">${metric.value}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="trend-metric-delta" style="color:${deltaColor}">${metric.delta}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="trend-metric-copy">${metric.copy}</div>
        ${readout}
        ${buildTrendSparkline(metric.values || [], metric.color || "#8b5cf6")}
        <div class="trend-axis"><span>${data.axis_start || ""}</span><span>${data.axis_end || ""}</span></div>
      </div>`;
  }).join("");
  shell.querySelectorAll(".trend-point-dot.active").forEach(function(dot) {
    updateTrendPoint(dot, Number(dot.dataset.pointIndex || 0));
  });
}

  localStorage.setItem(CUISINE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cuisinePrefs));
  renderCuisineChips();
  showCuisineToast();

  const selected = Object.keys(cuisinePrefs);
  if (!selected.length) return;
  let existing = document.getElementById("cuisineToast");
  if (!existing) {
    existing = document.createElement("div");
    existing.id = "cuisineToast";

  existing.style.opacity = "1";
  clearTimeout(existing._timer);
  existing._timer = setTimeout(() => { existing.style.opacity = "0"; }, 3000);
}

function removeCuisine(name) {
  delete cuisinePrefs[name];
  localStorage.setItem(CUISINE_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(cuisinePrefs));
  renderCuisineChips();
}

function addCustomCuisine() {
  const input = document.getElementById("customCuisineInput");
  const name = (input.value || "").trim();

  cuisinePrefs[name] = { selected_at: new Date().toISOString(), custom: true };

  input.value = "";
